frontendRoot.description: Absolute path to the frontend project root.

backendRoot.description: Optional. Absolute path to the backend project root. When provided, backend security checks run.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional. Live backend URL for security header checks. When absent, header checks are MANUAL-ONLY.

scope.description: Audit scope. 'full' audits the entire project. 'changed' focuses on files in changedFiles. 'components' limits to componentPaths.

changedFiles.description: When scope is 'changed', the files to focus on (from Pablo's component chain). Security-QA also always checks auth/config files regardless of scope.

componentPaths.description: When scope is 'components', the explicit source files to audit.

runNpmAudit.description: When true, run npm audit in frontendRoot. Default: true.

bobHandoffEnabled.description: When true, produce bobSecurityTests for HIGH/CRITICAL findings. Default: true.

susanHandoffEnabled.description: When true, produce susanValidationSteps for SOURCE-verifiable findings. Default: true.

blockOnSeverity.description: Pablo aborts the run if any finding meets or exceeds this severity. Default: 'high'.
